title: Veggie Dutch Casserole
description: A flavorful and nutritious Dutch-inspired casserole made with fresh vegetables, perfect for a gluten-free meal.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat 1 cup of Jubilant Vegetable Oil over medium heat.
Add the Vegetable Medley and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
In a separate pot, heat the Vegetable Broth over medium heat.
Stir in the Dutch Gouda Cheese until melted and well combined.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked Vegetable Medley, cheese mixture, and Casserole Mix.
Mix well and transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Drizzle the remaining 1 cup of Jubilant Vegetable Oil over the top of the casserole.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the casserole is golden brown and set.
Garnish with chopped Fresh Parsley and serve hot.
